items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Lenny Breau for instance has an extra string, only it’s a high string.

ctx.x: He made a big impression then. Is it always the lower string that’s added — on the seven string?

Well there are variations. Lenny Breau for instance has an extra string, only it’s a high string. And on the six string actually sometimes you tune it down to a D. This is a low A. And I’ve seen some tuned to low B flat.
